title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage
short_description: The pioneer 3D fighting series continues to evolve as Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage arrives on Steam! Featuring: Crossplay and Rollback Netcode support, a brand new single player mode: "World Stage", and more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 22H2 (OS Build 19045)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600, 3.5 GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 1300X, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570, 4 GB or Intel Arc A380, 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 22 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: 1080p Low @ 60 FPS w/ Balanced FSR 1.0, requires a CPU which supports the AVX and SSE4.2 instruction set. Microsoft no longer supports Windows 10 or older versions.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 22H2 (OS Build 19045)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790, 3.6 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 3.2 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6750, 12 GB or Intel Arc A770, 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 22 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: 4K High @ 60 FPS w/ Quality FSR or DLSS or XeSS, requires a CPU which supports the AVX and SSE4.2 instruction set. Microsoft no longer supports Windows 10 or older versions.
